defensible_abstention: Under the generated strict descriptions and supplied observation, null is justified. It does not establish physical irrecoverability.
coverage_gap: Original Pick can stop with open fingers near the cube; free requires separation/clear top access, partial requires closed or partly closed fingers.
evidence_limits: Pinch pose and gripper driver angle do not provide calibrated finger-surface geometry. Final cube speed is about 0.228 mm/s; this alone is weak evidence against settled state.
algorithm_gap: No null-resolution route; robot recovery starts only at partial clusters, human actions require resolved clusters. Known failure is also blocked from competence update by unresolved destination.
revision_scope: Only policies/pick.py changes. All state descriptions, option contracts, and edges remain unchanged.
